text: Zu Peshawar bus fares are charged by the distance travelled, not by the number of stops. title: Peshawar ZU System - Zu Peshawar
text: The Peshawar BRT system also known as “Zu Peshawar” in Pashto, meaning “Let’s Go Peshawar”, has a logo that references the city’s nickname as “the city of flowers”. The logo is designed to resemble flower petals that symbolize the freedom of movement that people will experience while using the system. Moreover, the petals represent the eco-friendly practices of the BRT system, which is one of its key benefits. The chosen logo features the letter “P” for Peshawar and a stylized roadway that conveys the concept of movement. The colour scheme of the logo includes maroon, which represents human warmth and vibrancy, and green, which is the national colour and evokes the idea of being environmentally friendly. TransPeshawar operates Zu buses on 13 different routes across the city, with a total of 244 buses, 30 on-corridor stations and 200 off-corridor bus stops. Some of the key features of the system are: • 27 km of dedicated corridor • 84 km of off-corridor coverage in the City • 30 on-corridor stations and 200 off-corridor bus stops • 4 Express routes and 1 Super Express Route • Universally accessible system, with elevators, escalators and ramps on all stations • Dedicated seats, waiting areas, and bus entrances for women • Dedicated seats for Transgenders • Card Recharge facilities at stations, through mobile app, jazz cash and easy paisa • CCTV monitoring of all stations and buses • Free WiFi on buses and stations • Passenger Complaint System

title: Lost and Found - Zu Peshawar
text: Passengers shall take care of their belongings and TransPeshawar shall not be responsible for stolen items/goods or any other items in buses or at the station or allied facilities. Passenger can register complaints about stolen items on Zu Helpline through (091) 111 477 477or Mobile App or website. REGISTRATION OF COMPLAINT about LOST AND FOUND GOODS Passenger(s) who have lost their goods/items in Zu Bus or Station shall call TransPeshawar Helpline at (091) 111 477 477 or lodge a complaint through Mobile App or Website. The passenger may also report at the ticket office or to the Station Manager. Similarly, Passenger (s) who found anonymous goods in Zu Bus or Station shall deposit at Ticket Office of the Station and inform the station manager followed by calling on TP Helpline. The station manager shall report the complaint of the passenger to the Control center.
